DPSC.description: PSC Design Parameters (DPSC). Fields configure AASHTO-LRFD24 prestressed-concrete design settings: tendon/exposure/corrosion options and the stress/strength check flags written to the design database. Singleton record: the only valid key is 1; DGNCODE must be 'AASHTO-LRFD24' (checked against the URL). GET returns not-found when the model's stored PSC code is a different AASHTO edition. Code-specific fields NATIONAL_ANNEX (LRFD17) and BRG_TYPE (LRFD07) accept only 0 here and are omitted on GET.

DGNCODE.description: PSC Design Code (fixed: AASHTO-LRFD24). Case-insensitive enum; wire value is 'AASHTO-LRFD24'.

TENDON_TYPE.description: Tendon Type (0=Low Relaxation Tendons, 1=Stress Relieved Tendons, 2=Prestressing Bars). Must be between 0 and 2.

EXPOSURE_FACTOR.description: Exposure Factor for Crack Width (0=Class 1 (1.0), 1=Class 2 (2.0), 2=USER). Must be between 0 and 2.

USER_FACTOR.description: [EXPOSURE_FACTOR=2] User Defined Exposure Factor; applied only when EXPOSURE_FACTOR=2. When assigned it must be > 0.

FLEXURAL_STRENGTH.description: Flexural Strength Calculation Method (0=Code, 1=Strain Compatibility). Must be 0 or 1.

NATIONAL_ANNEX.description: Amendment. AASHTO-LRFD17-only option; on this AASHTO-LRFD24 endpoint only 0 (Recommended) is accepted - a non-zero value is rejected with 'NATIONAL_ANNEX must be 0 (Recommended) except for AASHTO-LRFD17.' The field is omitted on GET and is always stored as 0 here. Best to omit it.

BRG_TYPE.description: Bridge Type (0=PC, 1=PRC). AASHTO-LRFD07-only option that drives the crack width check there; on this AASHTO-LRFD24 endpoint only 0 is accepted - a non-zero value is rejected with 'BRG_TYPE is only available for AASHTO-LRFD07.' The field is omitted on GET, and PUT/POST never overwrite the stored value here (even 0 is ignored). Best to omit it.

PRINCIPAL_STRESS_SLC_MAX_SHEAR.description: Principal Stress by Service Load Combination (Max Shear).

PRINCIPAL_STRESS_SLC_MAX_TORSION.description: Principal Stress by Service Load Combination (Max Torsion).

CRACK_CHECK.description: Crack Check Option (Only Composite Section Model).
